annotations.title: Ask acts about a booking, without an account

description: For someone WITHOUT a connected GigXchange account. Emails the person a link to check and send their request to up to 6 artists; nothing reaches any act until they open the email and press Send, which also creates their free account. Use the person's OWN email only. One request email per address a day; the link lasts 24 hours.

acts.description: The artists to ask, by profile SLUG from a search result (e.g. "the-nile-session"). 1-6.

budget.description: Optional budget in words, e.g. "around 500" (max 40 chars).

email.description: The person's OWN email address. The link to send the request goes here.

event_date.description: Optional event date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Leave out for "any date".

message.description: Optional note to the acts (max 300 chars).

org_name.description: The venue, promoter or agency name (max 80 chars). Required for venue, promoter and agent.

place.description: Where the event is - a town or venue (max 60 chars).

role.description: Who is booking: venue, organiser (a private event, party or wedding), promoter or agent.

name: request_hire_by_email
